stories.title: Timms Review: Changes to disability benefit could affect 12,000 people in Flintshire
stories.summary: More than 12,000 people in Flintshire who get Personal Independence Payment (PIP) could see changes to how the benefit is assessed and paid, after a government review published today set out plans to overhaul it. stories.title: Betsi review offers first clear path to improvement, says minister
stories.summary: Health Minister Mabon ap Gwynfor plans to appoint three new board members to deliver the review's 21 recommendations, with actions due within six months.

stories.title: Police appeal after suspicious incident at Chester Retail Park McDonald’s
stories.summary: Police have released CCTV images of a man they want to speak to after reports he entered the women’s toilets at a McDonald’s in Chester and began acting suspiciously. stories.title: Flintshire would see second-biggest council tax fall in Wales if reform went ahead, IFS says
stories.summary: Institute for Fiscal Studies figures show Flintshire bills would drop 5.9% under 2028 reforms the Welsh Government now wants to postpone to 2032.

stories.summary: Football fans using the Borderlands line to reach evening games at Wrexham’s Racecourse often have to choose between the final whistle and the last train home, two Senedd Members have said.
